title: Blitz-modpack
description: A Performance Modpack for insane frames :)
body:
# Blitz

Blitz is a performance modpack for 1.21.8, It features many mods to improve performace on the latest version of Minecraft released to date. If you wanted your game to run faster than the speed of light, that unfortunatly would'nt be possible with this modpack :( but atleast you would get fraction of those frames.


Try it yourself and let me know :)
